notes: Final leaf of the first Coates letter, pencil folio 46. It cites a Hodge paper as “Algebraic correspondances between surfaces, Proc. London Math. So[c/f]. Seeies 2, Vol XLIV, 1938, p.226”, then gives item 2 and discusses a proposed reduction to hypersurfaces. The citation and dates are transcribed as on the sheet; no bibliography was consulted. The original spellings Seeies, week, spcialisation and your’s are retained. Nearly is inserted above thirty years. In the first birationally, a dotted i is overtyped upon m; in will, the replacement l overlays a doubtful old h. The author attributes the objection “this cannot work … because such an X would have to be simply connected” to Serre. That objection and the dimension claims are recorded as the letter’s claims, without a proof check here. H’s following editorial heading and discussion of the next letter are not ink on this page and are excluded.
